name: a bare host whose last character before the dot is a symbol
why: The same autolink in ASCII. A renderer reads a host character as anything that is not punctuation or a space, so a symbol before the dot makes a host as surely as a letter does, and this fact reaches the page as href="http://1c$.sh". The rule is the shape of a host, not the letters it is spelled in.
fails: writes a link in a form this snapshot does not read
